example.title: Santa Cruz Municipal Wharf end platform
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: The outer end of the long timber wharf: a wide plank deck on timber pile bents with a white timber rail, benches and lamp posts, boat hoists at the rail, sea lions on the cross-bracing below, looking back over the bay to the beach and boardwalk rides. Three photos. Older than 1970: the wharf dates from 1914 (much rebuilt since). Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
